description: This file defines structures and an actor for executing hooks. It includes a data structure for hook jobs and an actor that manages running hook commands with concurrency control, environment setup, and timing constraints.

classes.name: HookJob
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a hook job with text and timestamp.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands, managing cooldowns, environment variables, and process execution timing.

methods.name: HookJob init
methods.description: Initializer for HookJob, sets text and timestamp.

methods.name: HookExecutor init
methods.description: Initializes the HookExecutor with configuration and hostname.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the hook should run based on cooldown timing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the hook command asynchronously with process management and timeout.
